title: Audit all agent AI invocations

title: Inject skills into all generation methods
Formalize Jules two-step generateStructuredResponse
description: In src/backend/src/ai/providers/vendors/jules.ts, ensure generateStructuredResponse uses the two-step pattern: Step 1 — call Jules generateText with the prompt concatenated with 'Respond with a JSON object matching this schema: ' + JSON.stringify(zodToJsonSchema(schema)). Verify the existing partial implementation in vendors/jules.ts and complete/formalize it.

title: Create AgentHealthService common base checks

Return structured { agentName, checks: { db: 'ok'|'error', ai: 'ok'|'error', ... }, timestamp }.

title: Create BaseAgent abstract class
description: Create src/backend/src/ai/providers/agent-support/base-agent.ts. Abstract class BaseAgent extends Agent<Env>. Properties: agentName (abstract readonly string), skills (protected readonly string[] = []), ai (public AIProvider), logger (public Logger), store (public AgentStateStore), hitl (public HumanInTheLoopService), memory (public optional EdigraphService). Methods: agentInit (protected optional async), onStart (async — initializes all properties, calls agentInit), ensureReady (protected async — guards uninitialized state), ping (@callable — returns pong with agentName + ts), healthProbe (@callable — calls AgentHealthService.baseChecks + agentHealthChecks), agentHealthChecks (protected async — returns {} by default, override per agent), buildFullHealth (private). Import AgentHealthService from './health-base'. Import HumanInTheLoopService from './hitl' (stub if not yet created).

Override buildFullHealth to include verifyChatFormat result as 'chat_format' key. This is the critical check that catches spinning wheel issues programmatically.

title: Add D1 mirror to AgentStateStore
description: In src/backend/src/ai/providers/agent-support/state-store.ts, modify set() and patch() to fire-and-forget mirror to D1 agentStateMirror table. Use onConflictDoUpdate. Handle DB errors silently (log warning, do not rethrow — DO state write must not fail because D1 mirror failed).

title: Create CollaborationService
description: Create src/backend/src/ai/providers/agent-support/collaboration.ts. CollaborationService class with constructor(env: Env). Methods: openCollaboration({ sessionId, initiator, participants: [{agentName, assignment, triggerCondition}], repoOwner?, repoName?, projectId? }) — creates D1 collaborations row + collaboration_participants rows + creates CollaborationRoom DO instance; sendCollabMessage(sessionId, from, message, metadata?) — posts to CollaborationRoom DO + inserts collaboration_events D1 row; triggerCollaborator(sessionId, agentName, prompt) — calls getAgentByName RPC on target agent, inserts collaboration_events row with type='trigger'; closeCollaboration(sessionId, outcome) — updates collaborations row status='closed'; listActive(repoOwner?, repoName?) — queries D1 collaborations WHERE status='active'. All operations logged via Logger. All write failures throw (collaboration integrity is critical).

title: Create HumanInTheLoopService

Add D1 schema for hitl_proposals, hitl_revisions, hitl_decisions tables.
